blocks.text: BTS, Cortis and Katseye have added new nominations for the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, strengthening the presence of K-pop-linked acts ahead of this year’s ceremony. MTV announced additional nominees Friday, with all three acts named in the Best Group category. BTS is now nominated in three categories, having previously earned nods for Song of the Year and Best K-pop with “Swim,” the lead track from the group’s fifth LP, “Arirang.” The group has a particularly strong history in the Best Group category, winning it four consecutive years from 2019 through 2022, the most wins by any act in the category.
